requirements.evidence: Default map + range fallback in app/Models/Queue.php:106-119; canonical-key/letter/uniqueness validation incl. uncovered defaults in Queue.php:130-153, enforced on every save with empty->null normalization (Queue.php:155-172); array cast (Queue.php:193) and not added to #[Fillable]. Ticket::nextCode scoped by queue, prefix and issue_date with malformed-skip and insertion order (app/Models/Ticket.php:233-257); 'issue_date' => 'date:Y-m-d' cast. IssueTicket reads the clock once ($now used for code day, issued_at, issue_date; IssueTicket.php:42-59). Migration adds nullable, backfills DATE(issued_at), makes NOT NULL, swaps unique index, has down() (2026_10_29_034016...:13-43). Factory derives issue_date from issued_at and allocates by priority/day (TicketFactory.php:35,292-305). UpdateQueue gains priorityPrefixMap with null/[]/validated semantics and ValidationException keyed priority_prefix_map (UpdateQueue.php:21-34). Docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain write stays in UpdateQueue action with existing Gate authorization (UpdateQueue.php:24); migrations have generator-style timestamps/stubs and reversible down(); mass-assignment kept deliberate (map not in #[Fillable], test at TicketPrefixTest.php:624-628); docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated; PHPDoc added on new public methods; tests updated and added in Pest style matching siblings.

security.evidence: Map is not mass-assignable; only changed through UpdateQueue after Gate authorize('update'); input validated in the model (regex /^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/ keys, /^[A-Z]$/ values) and translated to ValidationException; prefix is preg_quote'd in nextCode regex; unauthorized-change test at TicketPrefixTest.php:736-743. No UI/Livewire surface touched.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TicketPrefixTest.php covers default map by level and range (dataset), custom map + fallback, empty->null, every invalid-map case from the task (foo, -1, 010, xx, duplicates, {0:E}), mass-assignment protection, independent sequencing N/N/P/E/P, custom prefixes, midnight restart with single clock read, legacy/malformed skip, factory day/priority/explicit code, UpdateQueue set/keep/clear, invalid map leaves queue unchanged, unauthorized actor. Existing IssueTicketTest expectations migrated A->N without weakening. No test of the migration backfill itself (minor).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing nextCode scan logic and Gate; validation in one static method shared by model hook and action. Small redundancies: Queue::saving re-checks is_array after the array cast (Queue.php:166-168), and the factory performs an extra Queue::find when the relation is not loaded (TicketFactory.php:292).

readability.evidence: Clear names (defaultPrefixFor, assertValidPrefixMap, prefixForPriority), focused methods, updated docblock on nextCode explaining scope/ordering, comment on one clock read (IssueTicket.php:41) and index ordering in migration (034016:24). No dead code.

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: models, actions, factory, two migrations, tests, the three required docs. No UI, totem API or call-ordering changes.

issues.explanation: down() recreates unique(queue_id, code) and will fail once codes have restarted on later days (e.g. two N001 on different dates); not handled or documented.
The map is assigned to the in-memory $queue before name/slug validation runs, so a later ValidationException leaves the passed model instance dirty (DB is unchanged).
The DATE(issued_at) backfill and index swap are not covered by any test.
Extra Queue::find in afterMaking when the relation is not loaded; $ticket->queue lazy-load already does this, so the fallback is redundant.
is_array guard after an 'array' cast is effectively dead code.

review.summary: The change implements priority-derived ticket prefixes with per-queue validated custom maps, a daily per-prefix sequence backed by a new issue_date column and migrated unique index, single-clock issuance, factory alignment and UpdateQueue support, plus docs and a thorough Pest suite. Only minor issues remain (irreversible-in-practice down() after daily restarts, in-memory mutation before other validations, untested backfill), so it is approvable with nits.
